summary: Completed backend+frontend verification for live scan stream, stats accuracy, docs library behavior, and admin/public authorization gates on the external preview URL. Added focused regression pytest suite (14 tests, all passed) and validated terminal fixed-height behavior across desktop/tablet/mobile during idle/tabs/live scan. Public docs flows and report linking passed; admin UI CRUD could not be fully executed in browser because supplied admin env credentials are still rejected (known preexisting account/password mismatch).

integration_issues.issue: Blocked in browser because ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD signin returned 'Invalid email or password' for existing admin account (known preexisting mismatch). API-level admin CRUD was still validated using disposable QA user promoted via SQL.

action_items: Main agent: provision disposable admin credentials for browser-path admin UI CRUD retest (or sync env admin password with existing Supabase auth user if intended).
Re-run frontend admin manage/new/edit/delete workflow once admin signin succeeds in UI.
Keep current stream/stats/docs regression suite in CI to guard against fake counters, fake stream completion, and docs authorization regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: Known auth-account mismatch behavior remains: ensure_auth_user() creates users when missing but does not rotate/reset password for already-existing Supabase users, which explains env ADMIN_PASSWORD not guaranteeing browser login success.
Terminal layout implementation now correctly enforces fixed outer height (520 desktop / 540 mobile) with internal results scrolling; no downstream content displacement observed during live updates.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable QA-prefixed users/docs/scans during tests and cleaned exact QA rows afterward (qa-docs-* users/docs and linked scans).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public docs and stats currently return 22 published articles and checks_supported=14 after cleanup. Backend regression suite validates: stream started/check/complete semantics, persisted report parity, stats increments from real scan, advanced stream 403 ownership gate, invalid-domain 400, client-cancel no fake complete event, admin docs CRUD/version/conflict/validation rules, and auth gates (401 guest/403 non-admin). Frontend verified: hero scan stays on page, full report link works, report has docs links, docs mobile no overflow at 320/390, and AdminGate blocks anonymous/non-admin users.
rca of the issue: Admin UI E2E blockage RCA: backend startup seeding uses ensure_auth_user() that reuses an existing auth user without password reset; if existing Supabase admin account password differs from backend .env ADMIN_PASSWORD, browser login fails with 401 'Invalid email or password'. This is an account-state mismatch, not docs feature regression. Mitigation: use disposable promoted QA user for test runs (already done in backend API tests) or explicitly rotate existing admin password out-of-band before browser admin-flow validation.
